  Scenario: AC3 A caller without the right is refused (new, D-RCV-60)
    Given the caller lacks Reporting R on the read or lacks the step's service right
    When the caller reads the reported rows
    Then the caller gets 403 with the refusal, the user sees MSG-P4-002 and nothing changes

  Scenario: AC4 A statement that reaches another schema is refused (new, D-RCV-60)
    Given a component, a statement or a test reaches another `rwb_*` schema or a `v_ace_*` view
    When the statement runs
    Then the grant refuses the statement and the boundary test fails the build

  Scenario: AC5 A decision keeps the version it was taken under (new, D-RCV-60)
    Given a decision was taken under a rule version and a newer version has a valid-from date
    When the open account is recomputed
    Then the decision keeps its version and the new version applies from its valid-from date only

  Scenario: AC6 No personal data enters a row, an event, a workflow input or a log (new, D-RCV-60)
    Given a snapshot row, an event, a workflow input or a log is written for a changed account
    When the write completes
    Then it holds account and case references, codes, dates and counts only
